limitations: weak8 to rich8 changes covariance/amplitude and the training-noise stream; it is a full-flow support sensitivity, not an isolated noise-fixed covariance effect
rich8 to rich32 has exactly nested measured training records; asset, validation and future streams remain paired
positive M ranks the true candidate above these three rivals in attained conditional fits; it is not a calibrated rejection or topology probability
future-noiseless M removes future meter noise only; training and validation remain noisy
gate and global proxy completion concern different objects; retain raw-gate failures and inherited plans
times are recorded eleven-method studies under the execution load, excluding final source check and file write; not deployment speed claims
